title: What is Terraform? Infrastructure as Code explained
excerpt: Why teams define servers, networks and cloud resources in code.
body: Terraform lets teams describe infrastructure using declarative configuration files. Providers translate that configuration into operations against cloud platforms and other services.
Terraform compares the desired configuration with known infrastructure and creates an execution plan before applying changes.
Infrastructure as code makes environments more reproducible and reviewable, but teams must carefully manage state, secrets, modules and permissions.
